CmdhEcDefParamValues.label: CmdhEcDefParamValues
CmdhEcDefParamValues.description: This Object represents a specific set of default values for the CMDH related parameters Request Expiration Timestamp, Result Expiration Timestamp, Operational Execution Time, Result Persistence and Delivery Aggregation that are applicable for a given Event Category if these parameters are not specified in the message.

ApplicableEventCategory_.label: ApplicableEventCategory
ApplicableEventCategory_.description: Contains  list of Event Category values

DefaultRequestExpTime.label: DefaultRequestExpTime
DefaultRequestExpTime.description: Contains the default value for the Request Expiration Timestamp parameter when such a parameter is not set in the request

DefaultResultExpTime_.label: DefaultResultExpTime
DefaultResultExpTime_.description: Contains the default value of the Result  Expiration Timestamp parameter when such a parameter is not set in the request

DefaultOpExecTime.label: DefaultOpExecTime
DefaultOpExecTime.description: Contains the default value of the Operation Execution Time parameter when such a parameter is not set in the request

DefaultRespPersistence_.label: DefaultRespPersistence
DefaultRespPersistence_.description: Contains the default value of the Result  Persistence parameter when such a parameter is not set in the request

DefaultDelAggregation_.label: DefaultDelAggregation
DefaultDelAggregation_.description: Contains the default value of the Delivery Aggregation  parameter when such a parameter is not set in the request
